-------------------------SEC_PORTFOLIO----------------------------------
WITH CTE1 
AS(
SELECT convert(numeric(25,5),COUNT(*)) COUNT_tgt
,isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),ENDSHARES)),0) ENDSHARES_tgt
,isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),ENDVALUE)),0) ENDVALUE_tgt

, FILE_NAME, INSERT_DTTM 
FROM d360.STG_EDS_SEC_PORTFOLIO WHERE H = 'D'
GROUP BY FILE_NAME, INSERT_DTTM

)
,
CTE2 AS (
SELECT REPLACE(H,'F-','') COUNT_src
,ENDSHARES ENDSHARES_src
,ENDVALUE ENDVALUE_src

, FILE_NAME, INSERT_DTTM FROM d360.STG_EDS_SEC_PORTFOLIO WHERE H <> 'D'
)
,
CTE12 as (
SELECT COUNT_SRC, COUNT_TGT
,ENDSHARES_src
,ENDVALUE_src
,ENDSHARES_tgt
,ENDVALUE_tgt

, A.FILE_NAME, A.INSERT_DTTM, CONVERT(DATE,(left(right(A.FILE_NAME, 12),8))) DATE FROM CTE1 A
JOIN CTE2 B ON A.FILE_NAME = B.FILE_NAME AND A.INSERT_DTTM = B.INSERT_DTTM
)

INSERT INTO [EDS].[EDS_HASH_LOG_TBL]
SELECT 
FILE_NAME
,DATE
,insert_dttm
,REPLACE(METRICS,'_SRC','') METRICS
,SRC
,TGT 

FROM
(
SELECT
 CAST(COUNT_SRC AS numeric(25,5)) COUNT_SRC
,CAST(COUNT_TGT AS numeric(25,5)) COUNT_TGT
,CAST(ENDSHARES_src AS numeric(25,5)) ENDSHARES_src
,CAST(ENDVALUE_src AS numeric(25,5)) ENDVALUE_src
,CAST(ENDSHARES_tgt AS numeric(25,5)) ENDSHARES_tgt
,CAST(ENDVALUE_tgt AS numeric(25,5)) ENDVALUE_tgt
,FILE_NAME
,INSERT_DTTM
,[DATE]
FROM CTE12
) pvt

UNPIVOT
(
SRC FOR METRICS IN (COUNT_SRC
,ENDSHARES_src
,ENDVALUE_src

 )
) pvt1

UNPIVOT
(
TGT For METRICS2 IN (COUNT_TGT
,ENDSHARES_tgt
,ENDVALUE_tgt

 )
) pvt2
 
WHERE REPLACE(METRICS,'_SRC','') = REPLACE(METRICS2,'_TGT','');
